title: Planetary Rhythm Resonance
definition: The concept of a human's biological response to the natural rhythms and energies of the planet.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of your body as a tuning instrument, and the storm as a powerful musical performance. When you experience a storm, your body naturally resonates with it, causing a surge of energy and alertness.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Planetary rhythm resonance is the phenomenon where human biology directly interacts with the electromagnetic, infrasound, and ionic fields generated by a storm. This interaction triggers a series of physiological responses that can be traced back to our evolutionary history.
difficulty_levels.expert: Planetary rhythm resonance is a complex interplay of human biology and environmental physics. It involves the indirect coupling of human electrochemical signaling systems with the broader electromagnetic spectrum of a storm, as well as the subconscious decoding of environmental signals by the human body. This concept challenges the notion of a strict separation between human nature and the natural world, and highlights the potential for a more symbiotic relationship between the two.

extra_fields.insight: The human body's resonance with the natural rhythms of the planet is a direct, instinctive response that can be traced back to our evolutionary past.
